look_here_first: Check the broad tree crown and a whole bipinnate leaf with generally few primary pinna pairs. Thorny twigs and pale cylindrical flower spikes lead to long straw-colored mesquite pods, not yellow spherical flower balls.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Woody native Texas mesquite with loose canopy and bipinnate leaves

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Usually one or two pairs of main pinnae on each leaf; many relatively longer leaflets

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Paired thorns may develop at nodes; not sufficient alone

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Creamy yellowish flowers borne in elongated cylindrical spikes, NOT round pompons

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Long straw-yellow to tan pods, frequently several together
